description: This PHP source file defines the Vendors class which extends CRMEntity. It includes property declarations, methods for retrieving related data (such as products, purchase orders, contacts, emails), export functionalities, and dependency management related to the Vendors module of the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vendors
classes.description: Represents the Vendors module in vtiger CRM. Provides methods for managing vendor data, retrieving related entities such as products, contacts, purchase orders, exporting vendor data, and handling dependencies between records.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Placeholder for custom save logic; currently empty.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Retrieves products related to a specific vendor, generates a related list with optional actions.

methods.name: get_purchase_orders
methods.description: Retrieves purchase orders associated with a vendor, generates a related list.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a query to export vendor records based on the passed where condition.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to a specific vendor, generates a related list.

methods.name: get_emails
methods.description: Fetches email activity records related to the vendor.

methods.name: generateReportsQuery
methods.description: Returns the primary part of a report query for the Vendors module.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Returns the secondary part of a report query for related modules.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Defines relation tables for different secondary modules.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Removes dependencies and related records for the vendor, such as purchase orders and products.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Associates related records with the vendor, such as contacts and products.
